description: React functional component implementing session management UI with toggle, status display, and copy functionality for response/session IDs, integrated with Ant Design components and notifications.

methods.name: SessionManagement
methods.description: React functional component managing session display and controls based on API or UI session mode.

methods.name: handleCopySessionId
methods.description: Copies the current responsesSessionId to clipboard and shows success notification.

methods.name: getSessionDisplay
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current session or response ID display text.

methods.name: getSessionDescription
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string about the current session management mode.
